mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (from_uid, to_uid, message, status, create_time) VALUES (#{fromUid}, #{toUid}, #{message}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT fr.*, u.nickname AS from_nickname, u.avatar AS from_avatar FROM friend_request fr LEFT JOIN user u ON fr.from_uid = u.uid WHERE fr.to_uid = #{toUid} ORDER BY fr.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_request SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friend_request WHERE from_uid = #{fromUid} AND to_uid = #{toUid} AND status = 0 LIMIT 1
